# Community Summary

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CommunitySummary`](gmeow-CommunitySummary.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CommunitySummary>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/graphrag`](../../slices/graphrag.md)

A pre-generated summary of a community — GraphRAG's global-question substrate, [`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](../properties/gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md) the community's members and chunks and [`gmeow:wasGeneratedBy`](../properties/gmeow-wasGeneratedBy.md) its generating invocation (EXISTING provenance), hence revisable rather than a black box.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Summary`](gmeow-Summary.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CommunitySummary`](gmeow-CommunitySummary.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Summary`](gmeow-Summary.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
